the board and who register prior to the start of the meeting. The Board has established a
3-minute time limitation for comments to be taken into consideration by the Board.
Feedback will not be given during the Board Session. If a response is necessary, the
Board will respond within ten working days. Thank you. [Edgecombe County Board of
Education Policy 2310])
